Results.ReviewText: Q1200 is a hefty, solid grill in a good portable size and quality. Only negative might be that the fold-out wings feel like plastic and I am concerned that I will close them back on to the hot grill when I finish grilling.  Have grilled thick steaks and pork chops and am pleased with the outcome.
Results.Title: Solid product.

Results.ReviewText: Great for travel when space and weight need to be considered and great quality.
Results.Title: Q

Results.ReviewText: Light weight, easy to put together and move around.  Sturdy.  Starts great.  Bought it with a cast iron griddle, which works great for eggs/pancakes and sausages.
Results.Title: General

Results.ReviewText: I have had many grills during my lifetime but I like this one the most because of its compact size. Perfect for 2 to 4 people. Heats up evenly cooked very well. I would recommend to anybody needing a small portable grill.
Results.Title: Great size cooks very well

Results.ReviewText: Excellent small grill, no flare up. Grilled burgers, hot dogs, steaks and pork chops all came out perfect. Highly recommend!!!
Results.Title: Weber q1200

Results.ReviewText: We absolutely love this grill. We originally bought it for RV camping but we use it at home as well. Easy to use. Easy to clean. Cooks great!  We plan to order the griddle for it next.
Results.Title: RV & Home

Results.ReviewText: The size is a plus for singles, beach and camping outings. We small families now have something that is very useful.
Results.Title: Size is the the most popular.

Results.ReviewText: I had used my grill for about 4 months when it dawned on me (after burning several meals) that the thermometer never registered above 350.  I went to my dealer & they didn't have a replacement but urged me to contact Weber.  They couldn't have been more helpful.  Immediately a new thermometer was in the mail!  And, I learned I'm not a bad cook...just didn't know the importance of monitoring temperature!
Results.Title: Too much heat!

Results.ReviewText: I had several portable BBQ grills before, but this first Weber brand and most expensive. This BBQ grill has some nice features. However, few features that not meeting my expectation are; smaller cooking area and food sticking to the grates, even after I followed the manual steps. The price I paid, it is just average BBQ Grill.
Results.Title: Average Portable BBQ Grill

Results.ReviewText: Quality convenient perfect for 1-4 people and easy to store.    I bought the stand too and only use it at home but seems like would be great for camping.    I like to be able to bring it inside after use and one person can do this easily.    We are super happy with this purchase…  :)
Results.Title: Great product

Results.ReviewText: I’ve been a Weber owner and user for decades. They are the best!
Results.Title: LOVE MY WEBER Q!

Results.ReviewText: I am a huge BBQer! I used to get these barbecues that would sit out on my patio and the burner part would rust and corrode through one winter even with a balcony above and I would have a hard time finding replacement burners let along trying to get new igniter‘s. I bought this portable Weber barbecue literally 14 years ago and it has never stopped/ failed lighting, the burners have never rusted or needed replacement. The 300+ price at the time I thought was high but boy was it worth it! I’ve never seen a barbecue last like this and work flawlessly- all you have to do is replace the drip pans occasionally. AMAZING reliability!!! If I buy a house I may break down and get a Genesis ll but I am thrilled with this one which I use all the time!
Results.Title: Best barbecue I’ve ever had going on 14 years!

Results.ReviewText: Used our grill for the first time camping this past weekend and it worked great! Cooks fast and cleans up nicely.
Results.Title: Perfect Grill for Camping

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill!  The grates clean off so easily. And it’s a perfect size now that i am an empty nester.  It’s still big enough should i have the fam over.  Good job weber!
Results.Title: Love this grill!

Results.ReviewText:
The Q1200 is my first gas grill. Plenty of space to prepare a meal for family of 4-6 people in one go. The Q1200 is still easy to cary so you can bring it to the beach, picnic with friends or camping trip. I order red colour lid. It fits & looks great on my little patio. The lid arrived scratched in multiple areas, but I think that happened because the box during delivery was kept upside down.

Overall amazing quality, evenly cooking grill for a full chicken, stake, fish, wings, potatoes, vegetables, and whatever your imagination will bring on it!
Enjoy it.
Results.Title: Amazing Quality Grill

Results.ReviewText: I wish it had more temperature control.  On the lowest setting it still heats to 400 degrees'.
Results.Title: Nice But

Results.ReviewText: Perfect size for a quick grill!!  Very fuel efficient and easy to clean.
Results.Title: Weber 1200

Results.ReviewText: Great grill for two people who don't do much entertaining. Do not buy the itty-bitty grill cover that Weber recommends for this model -- buy the larger grill cover intended for the bigger model of this grill. The larger cover will fit perfectly and protect all of the controls.
Results.Title: Great for a small household.

Results.ReviewText: I was a little worried to begin with as the Q1200 is smaller than I’m used to. Not any more, it’s a great grill for my wife and I. Highly recommended!
Results.Title: Great grill highly recommended

Results.ReviewText: Neat little grill that is the right size and has the fold down side tables. This works great for our RV. Weber has really done a great job with this grill.
Results.Title: Neat little grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought this Weber for putting in the back on my Polaris Ranger because we like to hit the trails and it works great, I would recommend buying the cover as well, it helps keep the dust out when you are on the trails
Results.Title: Good for on the go

Results.ReviewText: Set up for the 1lb disposable, green propane canisters.  Works great.  Needs a stand or table to get it up off the ground.
Results.Title: Works and fits great.

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill for our motorhome. Gets hot fast, sears steaks nicely with the SS grates but does cool down quickly when you open the lid.
Results.Title: Love my Webers

Results.ReviewText: I had a problem with the regulator so I contacted Weber by phone. The rep was knowledgeable and immediately set up the order for a new one at no cost. I received it recently and it works good so far. The original one was never any good.
Results.Title: Regulator Issues

Results.ReviewText:
Greatest Camping/RV BBQ!
Love this BBQ...Never Fails
Results.Title: Great BBQ!

Results.ReviewText: I have been using a Q3000 for years and now I can take my baby Q with me on the road
Results.Title: Baby Q

Results.ReviewText:
This is our second table top Weber and we love it even more than our older one.  The electronic ignition is like my stove. It lights fast and comes to temperature fast.
We love it !
Results.Title: Best one out there

Results.ReviewText: I have bought three of them one for camping the other for home use that one at lest four times a week had that one five years and the regulator so I like it so much I bought the third one.
Results.Title: Weber Q 1200

ClientResponses.Response: Congratulations on your new Weber Q 1200 gas grill! We are excited for you to cook your first meal on it and let us know how it goes. Thank you for being a Weber fan!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: I have not yet used my new Weber grill.  Still have propane left to use with my old grill but look forward to the smaller scale
Results.Title: not yet

Results.ReviewText: I love this little grill.  I only have two issues.  First is that even at the lowest setting, the gtt try I’ll is pretty hot.  Second is that the optional grill cart is pretty wobbly.  Aside from that, the cooking performance is outstandingly.  It is also very easy to clean.
Results.Title: Big performance in a small package.
